title: Deep Structure of a Horse's Leg
content: “It’s amazing to watch him get right in there and start drawing with his brush. After that, the looseness of his blocking is wonderful because he knows where it’s going and he’s not afraid to just let the process play itself out.”—Aaron Blaise, co-director of Disney’s Brother Bear and founder ofCreatureArtTeacher.com69 minutes Widescreen, MP4 video.Digital download:SellfyGumroadCubebrushDVDDirect from manufacturer KunakiDVD at Amazon
